description: Each becomes a function returning a VNode. WelcomeBanner/Header use use_state for expanded; Loader uses use_frame(80) and reads frame index instead of System.monotonic_time. Their structs and @impl Component callbacks are deleted. Theme arrives via RenderContext (no more theme-as-positional-arg in Loader.render/3).
title: Convert leaf components: WelcomeBanner, Header, Loader, Footer
